name: challenge-4-example-city
description: The city the physical test track represents (docs/challenge-4-graph.png).
Transcribed from the 'Beispiel' dictionary in docs/01-information.md.
Nodes are intersections, edges are streets. A is the 4-way intersection,
B and C are T-junctions. An edge may carry at most one gate; because a gate
tag spans the whole street, it is direction-independent.
cyclically around an intersection, so 1 and 3 are opposite each other and 2
is always to the right of 1. A port that is absent has no street attached.
'nodes' maps node -> port -> [neighbour_node, neighbour_port] and must be
symmetric: if A port 1 leads to B port 1, then B port 1 leads back to A
port 1. load_city() validates this on startup.
